assets.what_it_does: Hierarchical, case-insensitive NTFS/POSIX file and directory mutex engine preventing race conditions and concurrent write corruption.
assets.who_it_helps: Multi-process CLI script authors, local automation builders, and developer toolkits running parallel tasks on Windows.
assets.remaining_work: Expose as clean standalone command-line mutex (`file-lock run --lock <path> -- <cmd>`); add timeout and stale lock recovery.
assets.delivery_format: Zero-dependency Node CLI or npm module
assets.reuse_value: HIGH: Cross-platform case-safe mutexing is notoriously error-prone on Windows.
assets.economic_unknowns: Developers expect OS-level locking to be free.
